item.description: ### Added - **Dock Click to Minimize** — click the active app's Dock icon to hide its windows Windows-style (without cluttering the minimized Dock tray) and click again to bring them straight back, plus send-to-back and minimize modes - **Clipboard History (`⌘ ⌥ V`)** — searchable floating clipboard dropdown with keyboard navigation, pinning, custom labels, password-manager filtering, and optional auto-paste - **Keep Awake (`⌘ ⌥ K`)** — reads `pmset` display sleep timing and nudges the cursor just before sleep and/or holds an IOKit power assertion for a quick timer or indefinitely - **Scroll Direction** — flip classic wheel-mouse scroll direction without touching trackpad or high-resolution scrolling - **Custom Commands** — bind global shortcuts to shell scripts, apps, URLs, or text snippets with optional toast feedback - **Menu-bar quick popover & JSON Config** — toggle Toolbox or individual modules, trigger actions from the menu bar, and edit `~/.config/toolbox/config.json` with live reload - **Inline update checker & custom update dialog** — silent inline progress bar, version badge, and last-checked timestamp in Settings, paired with a dark update dialog and persistent indicators across the sidebar, dashboard strip, and menu bar when a release is available
